2:

4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.

content.text:
Added a responsive analog joystick to **Pizza Panic**. Mobile and compact-screen players can drag the stick for smooth movement, with a separate dash button; keyboard controls remain available on desktop. The stick resets when released or when a round ends.

Verified JavaScript syntax, checked the mobile layout in Chromium, and confirmed the joystick responds and recenters after release. Screenshot: `/tmp/opencode/shots/mobile.jpg`.
